notes.title: Happy holiday, comrades!
notes.notes:
Dear comrades, we sincerely want to wish you a Happy New Year or Christmas! Wish you every success, good luck, health and all the very best for the new year 2022!

This year was not an easy one, we began to study game development, delve into the development process and did not have time to devote enough time to the game. Next year we will try to please you with both new updates and possibly new games!

Thank you very much for supporting us! Happy holiday, comrades!

notes.title: Update 1.1 "Penguins!"
notes.notes:
Major changes:
- Added a secret level (with a 20% chance on any difficulty)
- Added Steam achievements
- New "Penguin Theme" soundtrack
- Added animation of the flight of bombers to the attacked country

Bugs fixed:
- Visual bug on the map
- Visual loss bug
- Bug with the volume of sound effects

Code:
- Added improved localizer (will make it easier to add new languages ​​in the future)
- Optimized the system for saving statistics
- Added steamworks.NET features
